title: Above Demarchi et al.'s feedback threshold, do c40's dividing CIPS condensates also swim on their consumed fuel (SIMDE)?
summary: Demarchi et al. 2023 report that enzyme condensates self-propel above a feedback threshold. In c40's world the feedback is chi (drift up the product) and the catalysis rate kc. A scan could give condensates that swim, divide and depend on fuel in the same bodies.
experiment: c40 world.py, seed 0, 192^2, T=12000: scan chi in {3, 4.5, 6, 9} x Dp in {1, 0.3} (a slower product sharpens the gradient across a body); track condensate displacement in body lengths per life and persistent splits. Then the fork on the best arm. Success: tracks moving >= 3 body lengths between divisions on 2 seeds, with all bodies dying at the fuel fork.
